data.gender_notes: Ramjanam is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jana means people, mam means mother. So, Ramjanam means the one who is the delight of his people and the beloved of his mother. The name Ramjanam carries the meaning “Name of Lord Rama” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Ramjanam usually hope their child will grow to embody name of lord rama and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the devotion and dedication to Lord Rama and his teachings.
data.etymology: Ramjanam belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Name of Lord Rama.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ramjanam total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: In Hinduism, the name Ramjanam represents the divine embodiment of Ram (an avatar of Vishnu, one of the principal deities in Hinduism). The name holds immense cultural and emotional significance for Hindus, especially those living in North India, as Ram is considered the ideal of perfect human behavior, with exceptional virtues of righteousness, truthfulness, and selflessness. The name Ramjanam pays homage and reverence to the divine qualities of Ram and evokes a strong spiritual connection and emotional attachment among his devotees.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ramjanam delves deeper into the qualities of Lord Ram as being the beloved of his mother, conveyed by the Sanskrit term "Janani," which signifies "mother" in the phrase Ram Janaki, in reference to the devoted relationship between Ram and his mother, Queen Kausalya, highlighting the importance of the maternal love and the selfless devotion of motherhood in Hinduism. Thus, the spiritual significance of the name Ramjanam encompasses the perfect blend of love, devotion, and godliness.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ramjanam signifies the eternal abode or existence of Lord Rama, symbolizing devotion and longing for his divine presence. The name is a reminder to carry the essence of Lord Rama within, fostering virtues of truth, duty, and love.
